requirement: Validate incoming order XML files against an XSD with lxml and report every schema violation with its line number so users can fix the file in one pass.
skeleton: A SchemaLoadError, a frozen Violation dataclass, and an OrderValidator compiling etree.XMLSchema with a hardened parser, returning syntax errors as a violation, collecting the whole error_log sorted by line, and an is_valid helper.
caption: Validating order XML against an XSD with lxml and reporting every error with its line. SchemaLoadError is a plain Exception and Violation a frozen dataclass of line and message. OrderValidator parses the XSD with a parser built with resolve_entities=False and no_network=True and compiles etree.XMLSchema, turning etree.XMLSyntaxError or etree.XMLSchemaParseError into SchemaLoadError. violations parses the document with the same parser; an XMLSyntaxError becomes one Violation at its lineno with a syntax: message. Otherwise it validates, and on failure turns every entry of the schema error_log into a Violation sorted by line. is_valid returns whether there are none. The fixture asserts a clean document, all errors on lines 3 and 4 including the missing sku, no leakage between calls, syntax errors on the right line, and that a malformed or invalid XSD raises SchemaLoadError.

plan.intent: Give partners actionable feedback on uploaded order files
constraints: A malformed XSD or invalid schema raises SchemaLoadError
Syntax errors become one Violation with the parser's line number
Every schema error is reported, not just the first or last
Errors from one document do not appear in the next

rationale.teaches: Compile an XMLSchema once, call validate, then read every entry of schema.error_log with its line and message instead of raising on the first error.
rationale.why: Reporting only one error forces users through repeated uploads, and uncaught schema parse errors crash the service at startup.

ops.docstring: Validate XML documents against an XSD with lxml and report line numbers.

ops.source:
class SchemaLoadError(Exception):
    """Raised when the XSD itself is malformed."""

candidates.why_wrong: An XSD with an unknown element raises XMLSchemaParseError instead of SchemaLoadError.
Only the last schema error is reported and earlier violations are silently lost.
Syntax errors report the column offset as if it were the line number.
is_valid returns True for invalid documents and False for clean ones.
A document that fails to parse is reported as having no violations.
